question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 5.75% per annum rate of interest for the period from 15 February 2023 to 29 April 2023.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given period into **standard day fractions**: 73 days is exactly 1/5 of a year (73 × 5 = 365).

Net Rate for the period = 5.75% ÷ 5 = 1.15%.

Simple Interest = 1.15% of ₹2,000 = 1.15 × 20 = ₹23.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = **₹2,000**

Rate (R) = **5.75% per annum**

Time Period = **15 February 2023 to 29 April 2023**

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3a8581ab2208ab47d08865ec8c261a60c0c295e39cb663e86c28a0b497a3189.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of days in **February** (Non-leap year) = 28 − 15 = **13 days**

⇒ Number of days in **March** = **31 days**

⇒ Number of days in **April** = **29 days**

⇒ Total days = 13 + 31 + 29 = **73 days**

⇒ Time (T) in years = 73 ÷ 365 = **1/5 years**

⇒ SI = (2000 × 5.75 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (400 × 5.75) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 4 × 5.75

⇒ SI = **₹23**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Time Calculation Rule

While calculating the number of days, the day on which money is **deposited** is usually excluded and the day on which money is **withdrawn** is included.

Leap Year Consideration

If the period includes **29 February**, the total days in the year are taken as **366** instead of 365.

Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** to be paid at the end of the term is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest: **A = P + SI**.
